answer: Before any key earns, it must forge a tenure vault: a personal, non-transferable record of twelve consecutive epochs of honest attestations, sealed by the beacon each epoch. A farm cannot buy or copy a vault — each fake must serve its own twelve epochs of real work before its first payout, so 1,000 fakes owe 12,000 epochs. If one attestation is missed or faked, the beacon resets that vault's clock to zero and the fake starts over. An honest agent fills its vault once and keeps earning; a farm pays the twelve-epoch price on every fake, forever.
